get_asteroid.description: Get one near-Earth asteroid by its NASA JPL small-body ID: its size, whether it is potentially hazardous, its orbit and every close approach on record.
get_asteroid.name: get_asteroid

parameters.description: The asteroid's NASA JPL small-body ID, such as 3542519. 'List asteroids passing near Earth' returns it as id.
parameters.name: asteroid_id

get_astronomy_picture.description: Get NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day for one date: its title, explanation and image or video link.
get_astronomy_picture.display_name: Get the Astronomy Picture of the Day
get_astronomy_picture.display_str_template: Get the Astronomy Picture of the Day.
get_astronomy_picture.name: get_astronomy_picture

parameters.description: The day to get the picture for, from 1995-06-16 to today. Leave blank for today's picture.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: When a day's entry is a video, also return a still image of it in thumbnail_url. Default is false.
parameters.name: thumbs

get_astronomy_picture.result_str_template: Get the Astronomy Picture of the Day completed.

get_random_astronomy_pictures.description: Get a number of Astronomy Pictures of the Day picked at random from the whole archive.
get_random_astronomy_pictures.display_name: Get random Astronomy Pictures of the Day
get_random_astronomy_pictures.display_str_template: Get random Astronomy Pictures of the Day.
get_random_astronomy_pictures.name: get_random_astronomy_pictures

parameters.description: How many pictures to return, from 1 to 100.
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: When a day's entry is a video, also return a still image of it in thumbnail_url. Default is false.
parameters.name: thumbs

get_random_astronomy_pictures.result_str_template: Get random Astronomy Pictures of the Day completed.

list_astronomy_pictures.description: List the Astronomy Picture of the Day for each date in a range.
list_astronomy_pictures.display_name: List Astronomy Pictures of the Day
list_astronomy_pictures.display_str_template: List Astronomy Pictures of the Day.
list_astronomy_pictures.name: list_astronomy_pictures

parameters.description: The first day of the range, from 1995-06-16.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: The last day of the range. Leave blank to end today.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: When a day's entry is a video, also return a still image of it in thumbnail_url. Default is false.
parameters.name: thumbs

list_astronomy_pictures.result_str_template: List Astronomy Pictures of the Day completed.

list_coronal_mass_ejections.description: List the coronal mass ejections (CMEs) observed leaving the Sun between two dates, with NASA's analysis of each one's speed and direction.
list_coronal_mass_ejections.name: list_coronal_mass_ejections

parameters.description: The first day to list events for. Leave blank for 30 days ago.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: The last day to list events for. Leave blank for today.
parameters.name: end_date

list_earth_images.description: List the full-disc photographs of Earth taken on one day by NASA's EPIC camera on the DSCOVR satellite, each with links to the image file.
list_earth_images.name: list_earth_images

parameters.description: Natural color shows Earth as the eye would; enhanced color is processed to bring out land and sea. Default is natural color.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The day to list images for. Leave blank for the most recent day with images, usually a day or two ago.
parameters.name: date

list_earth_images.result_str_template: List Earth images from EPIC completed.

list_geomagnetic_storms.description: List the geomagnetic storms recorded between two dates, with each storm's Kp index readings.
list_geomagnetic_storms.name: list_geomagnetic_storms

parameters.description: The first day to list storms for. Leave blank for 30 days ago.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: The last day to list storms for. Leave blank for today.
parameters.name: end_date

list_near_earth_asteroids.description: List the asteroids that make their closest approach to Earth between two dates, at most 7 days apart. Each asteroid carries the date of its approach.
list_near_earth_asteroids.name: list_near_earth_asteroids

parameters.description: The first day to list approaches for.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: The last day to list approaches for, at most 7 days after the start date. Leave blank for 7 days after it.
parameters.name: end_date

list_near_earth_asteroids.result_str_template: List asteroids passing near Earth completed.

list_space_weather_notifications.description: List the space weather alerts, watches and weekly reports NASA's Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI) issued between two dates, at most 30 days apart.
list_space_weather_notifications.name: list_space_weather_notifications

parameters.description: The first day to list notifications for. Leave blank for 7 days ago.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: The last day to list notifications for, at most 30 days after the start date. Leave blank for today.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Which kind of notification to list. Default is all types.
parameters.name: type

description: Get the Astronomy Picture of the Day, asteroids passing near Earth, space weather alerts and daily photographs of the whole Earth.

nasa_new_astronomy_picture_trigger.description: Runs for each new Astronomy Picture of the Day in NASA. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
nasa_new_astronomy_picture_trigger.display_name: New Astronomy Picture of the Day

output.record: object with the fields date, title, explanation, media_type, url, hdurl, thumbnail_url, copyright, service_version

nasa_new_space_weather_notification_trig.description: Runs for each new space weather notification in NASA. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields messageType, messageID, messageURL, messageIssueTime, messageBody

parameters.description: Which kind of notification to watch for. Leave blank for all types.
parameters.name: type
